summary: Pharming Group N.V., a Nasdaq/Euronext-listed Dutch biotech, filed a Form 6-K furnishing a September 25, 2026 press release disclosing FDA acceptance of a supplemental New Drug Application for lower doses of Joenja (leniolisib) in children aged 4 years and older weighing 13-27 kg with APDS. The FDA granted Priority Review with a PDUFA target action date of January 30, 2027. The sNDA rests on Phase III open-label data showing reduced lymphadenopathy and increased naive B cells over 12 weeks. No deal terms, advisors, or board recommendations are stated; this is a routine regulatory milestone, not a special situation.
